summary.text: Gu as Before Formation is an immortal Gu formation Fang Yuan constructs to halt the destruction of fixed space Gu.

claims.text: After the time path clone recovers, deductions yield immortal Gu formation Gu as Before Formation. Fang Yuan spends energy and succeeds in constructing it. He takes fixed space Immortal Gu from Liu Hao’s immortal aperture. Almost at once the Gu shows signs of detonating. The formation is already active and affects that destruction. Fixed space Gu flickers, the refinement path dao marks on it are destroyed, and after a while it returns to a stable condition with slight injuries.

In his previous life, Heavenly Court’s hidden methods destroyed fixed space Gu. From those fragments he obtained the hope of conceptualizing Immortal Gu Gu as Before, and he never stopped deducing that matter. With that accumulation, this life reaches an initial success: the formation. It involves millions of Gu worms and more than twenty Immortal Gu from refinement path, time path, and rule path. What he envisions is Gu as Before Immortal Gu, so this formation is only an initial success. Modifying and simplifying the large formation into a practical killer move would be mid-stage success. Condensing that killer move into an Immortal Gu recipe and refining Gu as Before Immortal Gu would be complete success. Currently the formation is his limit. He needs a deeper foundation, including refinement path contents Heavenly Court likely holds from Old Eccentric Tian Nan and Old Immortal Kong Jue, before he can simplify it into a killer move.

After losses on Myriad Year Flying Warship, countless mortal Gu can be replaced, but injuries of Immortal Gu are the most troublesome. Fang Yuan has Gu as Before Formation. His refinement path foundation is robust enough that he can restore those Immortal Gu.
